Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Board

Class PlayerBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Board.PlayerBoard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerBoard extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a player's board where cards are placed and objectives are scored. This class manages the placement of cards, updates of playable positions, and scoring of objectives. It also handles dynamic updates to the player's inventory based on card placements.
